name: Asenath
overview: Asenath, introduced in Genesis 41, is the wife of Joseph and the daughter of Potipherah, a priest of On. Scripture highlights her role as the mother of Joseph's two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, who were born before the famine. Joseph's naming of Manasseh reflects God's grace in helping him forget his past hardships, underscoring God's providence in Joseph's life and family line.
